content.title: Withdraw the only tracked submission and restore the shared package seat count
content.intent: Prove that withdrawing the current session's only tracked submission removes it from `/my-submissions`, returns one seat to the package's shared monthly pool, and leaves the session with no tracked submissions.
content.technique_notes: Techniques: equivalence partitioning + state / flow + CRUD round-trip. I used the representative tracked state of exactly one current-session submission because the source promises one-row withdrawal behavior and a one-seat restoration delta on the shared `/publish` pool. No covering array was needed because this journey has no independent multi-input interaction to combine; the risk-judged default strength would be 2 because no money, auth, or data-loss factor applies to this use-case.
